name: secret-fingerprint
title: Secret Fingerprint
description: SecretFingerprint: the masked display of a stored secret, •••• 1a2b in a monospace font, from the few characters your server derives. The mask is hidden from screen readers, which hear "Ending in 1a2b" (labels). It takes only fingerprint, a string or null, so the secret itself never reaches it.
docs:
`<SecretFingerprint fingerprint="1a2b" />` shows `•••• 1a2b` in `font-mono`; the dots are `aria-hidden`, and screen readers and agents read `labels.fingerprint("1a2b")`, "Ending in 1a2b" by default. `fingerprint={null}` shows `••••` alone and reads `labels.none`, "No fingerprint".

It has no `value` prop and slices nothing: pass the characters your server already derived, so a whole secret can never reach the DOM through it. The fingerprint isn't secret, so agents may read it. SecretList uses it for every configured secret, and a DeviceApproval item can show it as its `detail`. It has no dependencies beyond `utils`.
